gate.agree_def: share of items with equal parsed predictions (None == None agrees), bs-1 INTACT vs official-semantics virtual bs 128

qdrop.def: fresh '<bot> z_1..z_6 <eot>' with the item's own INTACT z, positions 0..; k0 = '<bot> <eot>' (one constant output)

qmask.def: answer phase (<eot> + generated queries) cannot attend to question tokens 0..Lq-1 (all layers; additive key mask, positions unchanged)

logit_lens.def: U4: z_j via the tied LM head (no ln_f); h_j = final-layer (ln_f) hidden at latent position j; top number token among 1691 numeric ids

pairs_meta.rule: np rng 22020; recipients ascending; donor uniform among INTACT-correct, gold differs, same question token length, uses < 3

variants.def: CACHE-SWAP variants on the primary pairs (same order): k_only / v_only = keys / values only (6 latent rows, all layers); last_row = the 6th latent row only (k+v, all layers); layers_lo / layers_hi = layers 0..5 / 6..11 (6 rows, k+v)

prefix.def: STATE-SWAP of z_1..z_k only (later z computed by the recipient), primary pairs, same order

scit.def: U5; candidates per primary pair (same order); summed log-prob of '<eot>'-conditioned 'The answer is: N'+EOS under CACHE-SWAP and STATE-SWAP

graph_matched.def: Δ = 0 graph-matched pairs (np rng 22021; U6); int-follow = out == ocf

graph_matched_dne0.def: graph-matched pairs with Δ != 0 (separate descriptive row, never pooled; CACHE-SWAP is reverse-distance and position-UNCORRECTED)
